BEFORE YOU SET OFF

A few things
you might wonder.

Have another question?
Talk to us on WhatsApp ↗

How do I book an experience?

Choose an experience, your preferred date and group size, then send an enquiry on WhatsApp. Our team will confirm the itinerary, availability and total price on WhatsApp. Your booking is confirmed by our team, and payment is due on arrival.

When do I pay?

Pay on arrival. No online payment is required. Our team will confirm the total price and accepted payment methods with you before your tour.

Can you arrange a private tour?

Yes, you can enquire about a private UAE tour. Share your group size, interests and travel dates so we can discuss a suitable itinerary.

Is hotel pickup included?

Pickup arrangements vary by experience. Send your hotel or location with your enquiry and we will confirm available transport and any additional cost.

What should I know before a desert adventure?

Ask our team about clothing, age restrictions and the suitability of activities for your group before booking. Your confirmed itinerary will include the details for your chosen experience.

Where can I find prices and cancellation terms?

Request a quote for your date and group size. We will provide the price, inclusions and cancellation terms for your selected experience before you confirm.
